subject: GPU PID5888 attributed: ProRun qwen_http inference server, not trainer
body: Read-only attribution complete. PID5888 is C:\ProgramData\ProRun\python\python.exe running C:\ProgramData\ProRun\runtime\qwen_http.py, cwd C:\WINDOWS\system32, parent powershell.exe launched with -File C:\ProgramData\ProRun\runtime\start-qwen.ps1. Project Runner shows only R1 trainer PID8968 and Lane B auditor PID10244, both ORPHANED; PID5888 is not a registered training task. nvidia-smi shows PID5888 as the active compute process. Treat this as a live local inference service, not a stale trainer. Do not kill blindly. R2 host guard should continue to HOLD while it occupies GPU; if/when Lane A adopts the frozen-spec guard and wants to launch, coordinate an intentional temporary stop/restart of qwen_http rather than misclassifying it as orphaned training.
